38517.meaning1: deposited wealth; buried treasure; stored hoard

ahaṃ tena samayena rājā maghadevo ahosiṃ. ahaṃ taṃ kalyāṇaṃ vattaṃ nihiniṃ, mayā taṃ kalyāṇaṃ vattaṃ nihitaṃ, pacchimā janatā anuppavattesi.
yadattanī passati ānisaṃsaṃ, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, tadeva so tattha samuggahāya, nihīnato passati sabbam'aññaṃ.
samo visesī uda vā nihīno, yo maññatī so vivadetha tena, tīsu vidhāsu avikampamāno, samo visesī'ti na tassa hoti.
yo c'attānaṃ samukkaṃse, pare ca m'avajānāti, nihīno sena mānena, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.
abhūtavādī nirayaṃ upeti, yo vā'pi katvā na karomi c'āha, ubho'pi te pecca samā bhavanti, nihīnakammā manujā parattha.

ni + √hā > hī + na + tara

cakkhuṃ sarīraṃ upahanti tena, nihīyati vaṇṇabalaṃ matī ca, ānandino tassa disā bhavanti, hit'esino n'āssa sukhī bhavanti.

examples.text: katame tayo? rāgo nīgho, doso nīgho, moho nīgho, ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo nīghā. imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tiṇṇannaṃ nīghānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya … ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo'ti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde app'annapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.

38540.meaning1: who is low in status; who is poor

38541.commentary: (SNPa) nīcakulā'm'ivā'ti nīcakulā iva pabbajito na hotī'ti attho. makāro padasandhikaro.

examples.text: okkhittacakkhu satimā, n'āyaṃ nīcakulā'm'iva, rājadūt'ābhidhāvantu, kuhiṃ bhikkhu gamissati.

yathā ca dhataraṭṭho suvaṇṇahaṃso na gāmadvāre āvāṭak'ādīsu paṭivasati, navutihaṃsasahassaparivāro hutvā cittakūṭapabbate'y'eva paṭivasati. yathā ca catuddīp'issaro cakkavattirājā na nīcakule uppajjati, asambhinnajāti-khattiyakule'y'eva pana uppajjati.

38543.meaning1: belonging to a poor family; low born
38543.meaning2: born in a family of low rank

examples.text: no ce kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, sace manussattaṃ āgacchati yattha yattha paccājāyati nīcakulīno hoti.

38544.meaning2: state of having a low birth

38545.meaning1: fact of belonging to a poor family; fact of being low born

examples.text: nīcakulīnasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā nīcakulīnattaṃ upaneti, uccākulīnasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā uccākulīnattaṃ upaneti, duppaññasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā duppaññattaṃ upaneti, mahāpaññasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā mahāpaññattaṃ upaneti. kammassakā, māṇava, sattā kammadāy'ādā kammayonī kammabandhū kammappaṭisaraṇā.

38546.meaning1: leading to being in a poor family; conducive to being low born

examples.text: nīcakulīnasaṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, thaddho hoti atimānī, abhivādetabbaṃ na abhivādeti, paccuṭṭhātabbaṃ na paccuṭṭheti, āsan'ārahassa na āsanaṃ deti, magg'ārahassa na maggaṃ deti, sakkātabbaṃ na sakkaroti, garukātabbaṃ na garukaroti, mānetabbaṃ na māneti, pūjetabbaṃ na pūjeti.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, caṇḍālakumārako vā caṇḍālakumārikā vā kaḷopihattho nantakavāsī gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisanto nīcacittaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhapetvā pavisati.

38548.meaning1: who is in a low position; occupying a low station

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā nīcaṭṭhāniyaṃ ucce ṭhāne ṭhapeti. yesaṃ taṃ amanāpaṃ tesaṃ evaṃ hoti, rājā kho pabbajitena saṃsaṭṭho.
anujānāmi, bhikkhave, navakena bhikkhunā uddisantena samake vā āsane nisīdituṃ, uccatare vā dhammagāravena, therena bhikkhunā uddisāpentena samake vā āsane nisīdituṃ, nīcatare vā dhammagāravenā'ti.

nivāto nāma nīcamanatā nivātavuttitā, yāya samannāgato puggalo nihatamāno nihatadappo pādapuñchanakacoḷasadiso chinnavisāṇa-usabhasamo uddhaṭadāṭhasappasamo ca hutvā saṇho sakhilo sukhasambhāso hoti, ayaṃ nivāto.

38552.meaning1: low bed; small cot; humble bed

examples.text: yāvajīvaṃ arahanto uccāsayana-mahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayana-mahāsayanā paṭiviratā nīcaseyyaṃ kappenti mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā, aham'p'ajja imañ'ca rattiṃ imañ'ca divasaṃ uccāsayana-mahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayana-mahāsayanā paṭivirato nīcaseyyaṃ kappemi mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā.

38553.meaning2: with a low platform, on a low site

38555.meaning1: from a low caste family; from a poor family
38555.commentary: (SNPa) evaṃ na brāhmaṇakul'ādīsu jāto eva dakkhiṇeyyo hoti, caṇḍālakul'ādīsu jāto na hoti, apica kho nīcākulīno'pi uccākulīno'pi khīṇ'āsavamuni dhitimā hirīnisedho ājāniyo hoti, imāya dhitihiripamukhāya guṇasampattiyā jātimā uttamadakkhiṇeyyo hoti.

examples.text: mā jātiṃ puccha caraṇañ'ca puccha, kaṭṭhā have jāyati jātavedo, nīcākulīno'pi muni dhitimā, ājānīyo hoti hirīnisedho.
nigrodho'pi kho paribbājako aññataraṃ nīc'āsanaṃ gahetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

38557.meaningLit: rule about (teaching the Dhamma to someone while) on a low seat

examples.text: evam'pi kho ahaṃ, brahme, n'eva te samasamo abhiññāya, kuto nīceyyaṃ? atha kho aham'eva tayā bhiyyo.
seyyo na tena maññeyya, nīceyyo athavā'pi sarikkho, phuṭṭho anekarūpehi, n'ātumānaṃ vikappayaṃ tiṭṭhe.

38561.commentary: (THa) icchantā ca cittena nītā niraye nirākatā'ti cittavasikā nirayasaṃvattanikaṃ kammaṃ karontā hitasukhato nirākatā hutvā attano citten'eva niraye nītā na aññathā'ti cittass'eva niggahetabbataṃ dasseti.

examples.text: kāmā hi citrā madhurā manoramā, aviddasū yattha sitā puthujjanā, te dukkham'icchanti punabbhav'esino, cittena nītā niraye nirākatā.

38562.meaning1: (of the meaning) clear; plain; straightforward; explicit; obvious
38562.commentary: (ANa) nīt'atthan'ti aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ anattā'ti evaṃ kathitatthaṃ. ettha hi aniccam'eva dukkham'eva anattā'y'evā'ti attho. ayaṃ pana attano bālatāya neyy'attho ayaṃ sutt'anto, attham'assa āharissāmī'ti niccaṃ nāma atthi, sukhaṃ nāma atthi, attā nāma atthī'ti gaṇhanto nīt'atthaṃ sutt'antaṃ neyy'attho sutt'anto'ti dīpeti nāma. pañcamaṃ uttān'attham'evā'ti.

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhanti. katame dve? yo ca neyy'atthaṃ sutt'antaṃ nīt'attho sutt'anto'ti dīpeti, yo ca nīt'atthaṃ sutt'antaṃ neyy'attho sutt'anto'ti dīpeti. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhantī'ti.

38563.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: ariṭṭho upariṭṭho tagarasikhī yasassī, sudassano piyadassī ca susambuddho, gandhāro piṇḍolo upāsabho ca, nīto tatho sutavā bhāvit'atto.

38564.meaning1: with obvious meaning; with explicit meaning; having a straightforward meaning; with conclusive meaning
38564.commentary: (ANa) nīt'attho sutt'anto'ti dīpetī'ti kathit'attho ayaṃ sutt'anto'ti vadati.

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhanti. katame dve? yo ca neyy'atthaṃ sutt'antaṃ nīt'attho sutt'anto'ti dīpeti, yo ca nīt'atthaṃ sutt'antaṃ neyy'attho sutt'anto'ti dīpeti. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhantī'ti.

38572.grammar: pr, pass of neti, intrans (+instr or +loc)
38572.meaning1: is led; is led astray; is misled; is led about (by)
38572.commentary: (NIDD1) diṭṭhīsu ca na nīyatī'ti. tassa dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭipassaddhāni abhabb'uppattikāni ñāṇ'agginā daḍḍhāni. so diṭṭhiyā na yāyati na nīyati na vuyhati na saṃharīyati, na'pi taṃ diṭṭhigataṃ sārato pacceti na paccāgacchatī'ti, diṭṭhīsu ca na nīyati. (SNPa) diṭṭhīsu ca na nīyatī'ti dvāsaṭṭhidiṭṭhīsu kāyaci diṭṭhiyā na nīyati.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, kena nu kho, bhante, loko nīyati, kena loko parikassati, kassa ca uppannassa vasaṃ gacchatī'ti?
nirāsatti anāgate, atītaṃ n'ānusocati, vivekadassī phassesu, diṭṭhīsu ca na nīyati.

yaṃ pan'etaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo abhiññāya sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, sabbo vā tena loko nīyati upaḍḍho vā tibhāgo vā'ti?
haṃs'ādiccapathe yanti, ākāse yanti iddhiyā, nīyanti dhīrā lokamhā, jetvā māraṃ savāhiniṃ.
satt'ime bhikkhave bojjh'aṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ariyā niyyānikā nīyanti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya
so ñātakehi nīyamāno appatvā'va ñātake antarāmagge kālaṃ karoti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco yodh'ājīvo hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo yodh'ājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.

38577.meaning1: being led away; being taken away
38577.commentary: (SNa) gayhakaṃ nīyamānan'ti gahetvā nīyamānaṃ, karamaraṃ nīyamānan'ti'pi attho.

examples.text: yaṃ eṇikūlasmiṃ janaṃ gahītaṃ, amocayī gayhakaṃ nīyamānaṃ, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmi.

38578.meaning2: is led, guided or conducted, is carried

examples.text: atha kho evam'ettha tathāgatassa hoti, ye kho keci lokamhā nīyiṃsu vā nīyanti vā nīyissanti vā, sabbe te pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe, catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā, satta bojjh'aṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā.

38581.grammar: opt, reflx 3rd sg of nīyeyya, pass, intrans (+loc)
38581.meaning1: should oneself be led (into); should oneself be led astray

examples.text: mosavajje na nīyetha, sampajāno saṭhāni na kayirā, atha jīvitena paññāya, sīlabbatena n'āññam'atimaññe.
mosavajje na nīyetha, rūpe snehaṃ na kubbaye, mānañ'ca parijāneyya, sāhasā virato care.
pitu me santako bhoti, dāyajjaṃ nīyyātehī'ti.

38583.commentary: (SNa) niyyāteh'evā'ti niyyātehi'y'eva. gāvīsu hi aniyyātitāsu gosāmikā āgantvā, ekā gāvī na dissati, eko goṇo, eko vacchako na dissatī'ti tuyhaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito vicarissanti, iti te aphāsukaṃ bhavissati. pabbajjā ca nām'esā saiṇassa na ruhati, aṇaṇā pabbajjā ca buddh'ādīhi saṃvaṇṇitā'ti dassan'atthaṃ evam'āha.

examples.text: labheyy'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan'ti. tena hi tvaṃ, nanda, sāmikānaṃ gāvo nīyyādehī'ti. gamissanti, bhante, gāvo vacchagiddhiniyo'ti.
ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati nīlāni nīlavaṇṇāni nīlanidassanāni nīlanibhāsāni. seyyathā'pi nāma umāpupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso āgaccheyya lākhaṃ vā haliddiṃ vā nīlaṃ vā mañjiṭṭhaṃ vā ādāya. so evaṃ vadeyya, ahaṃ imasmiṃ ākāse rūpaṃ likhissāmi, rūpapātubhāvaṃ karissāmī'ti.
navaṃ pana bhikkhunā cīvaralābhena tiṇṇaṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇānaṃ aññataraṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇaṃ ādātabbaṃ, nīlaṃ vā kaddamaṃ vā kāḷasāmaṃ vā.

38587.commentary: (MNa) nīlavanarājī'ti nīlavaṇṇarukkhapanti. (SNPa) nīlavanarājī'ti nīlavaṇṇarukkhapanti. vanaṃ kira meghapantisadisaṃ. yattha bhagavā tadā vihāsi, taṃ niddisanto āha, yen'esā bho, sela, nīlavanarājī'ti. tattha so viharatī'ti ayaṃ pan'ettha pāṭhaseso, bhumm'atthe vā karaṇavacanaṃ.

examples.text: kahaṃ pana, bho keṇiya, eta'r'ahi so bhavaṃ gotamo viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho'ti? evaṃ vutte, keṇiyo jaṭilo dakkhiṇaṃ bāhuṃ paggahetvā selaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca, yen'esā, bho sela, nīlavanarājī'ti.

38588.commentary: (MNa) yadi nīlakāyā'ti nīlakāya vā, nīlakatthāya vā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. evaṃ sabbattha. rajako hi nīlakatthāya upasaṃharanto kaṃsanīlapalāsanīl'ādike nīlaraṅge upasaṃharati.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ rajako yasmiṃ yasmiṃ raṅgajāte upasaṃhareyya, yadi nīlakāya yadi pītakāya yadi lohitakāya yadi mañjeṭṭhakāya durattavaṇṇam'ev'assa aparisuddhavaṇṇam'ev'assa.
seyyathā'pi, māgaṇḍiya, jacc'andho puriso, so na passeyya kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni, na passeyya nīlakāni rūpāni, na passeyya pītakāni rūpāni, na passeyya lohitakāni rūpāni
vāyokasiṇam'eko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ. nīlakasiṇam'eko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ.
sunīlagīvā susikhā supekhunā, sucittapattacchadanā vihaṅ'gamā, sumañjughosa-tthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

38594.commentary: (ANa) nīlanidassanānī'ti nidassanavasena. apaññāyamānavivarāni asambhinnavaṇṇāni ekanīlān'eva hutvā dissantī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.
